parse.title: The Fremennik Isles
parse.wikitext:
==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Mord Gunnars]] at the northernmost dock of [[Rellekka]].
|startmap = 2646,3710
|difficulty = Experienced
|description = Sibling rivalry can get messy - more so when the siblings are Fremennik princes with a point to prove. The islands of Jatizso and Neitiznot were set up by two brothers who hated each other, and they have been at loggerheads ever since. But now there is a new threat from trolls in the north...

Can you prove your loyalty to both brothers and save the islanders from a fate as troll food? Your skills as a Fremennik warrior, a bridge builder and... a jester will be tested on the islands.
|length = Medium
|requirements = *Completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]]
*{{SCP|Construction|20|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}}  {{Questreqstart|no}} <ref>Only required to fix the bridges later in the quest.</ref>
*The ability to kill a level 122 [[Ice Troll King|Troll King]] (Damage can be reduced) and, separately, 10 rock throwing [[ice troll]]s in a [[multicombat area]].
|recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|50|link=yes}}
*{{SCP|Agility|40|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} to optionally go to the [[Central Fremennik Isles mine]]
*{{SCP|Prayer|43}} for [[Protect from Melee]]
*A [[Catspeak amulet]] for amusing dialogue during the initial conversation with Jatizso's king
*[[Food]]/[[armour]] at all times (in case you get attacked by trolls on the northern island)
*[[Prayer potion]]s - as there is no [[altar]] close by
*Good [[combat]] [[equipment]] to kill 10 low-[[Defence]], high-[[Attack]] monsters, and one level 122
**A [[melee]] [[weapon]] and decent melee stats - as the [[Ice Troll King]] has very high [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] [[Defence]]
**An emergency teleport
|items = *A [[raw tuna]] (obtainable during quest, with 35 fishing or bought from the shop)
*Either 8 [[tin ore]]s, 7 pieces of [[coal]], or 6 [[mithril ore]]s (depends on your [[Mining]] level; level 1 will require tin ore, 2-54 will require coal, and 55-99 require mithril ore). '''Note:''' The ores can be noted.
*9 [[rope]]s (obtainable during quest with {{SCP|Crafting|30|link=yes}})
**If the [[Neitiznot shield]] is already purchased, only 8 ropes are required.
*A [[knife]]
*8 [[split log]]s (obtainable during the quest with 56 Woodcutting and an axe)
*a [[Neitiznot shield]] (or 56 Woodcutting, a [[hammer]] and a [[bronze nail]])
*[[Yak-hide armour (top)|Yak-hide armour top]] and [[Yak-hide armour (legs)|legs]] (or 46 Crafting, a [[needle]] and two [[thread]], or a [[costume needle]])
*5000 [[coins]] (optional)
*[[Silly jester costume]] (obtained during quest)
|kills = *10 [[Ice troll (disambiguation)|Ice Troll]]s ''(level 74-82)''
*[[Ice Troll King]] ''(level 122)''
|ironman = *{{SCP|Woodcutting|56}} [[Woodcutting]] Required to make a Neitiznot shield with a [[hammer]] and one [[bronze nail]]
*{{SCP|Crafting|46}} [[Crafting]] Required to make yak-hide armour with a [[needle]] and a [[thread]]
*An [[axe]]
 [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] The player will need to hand 8 items in at once.
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}
